# Syrabit.ai

> Free, AI-augmented study notes, MCQs, and explanations for AHSEC
> (Assam Higher Secondary Education Council — Class 11 & Class 12),
> SEBA (Class 9 & 10), and FYUGP (Degree, NEP) syllabi. English
> canonical content with verified Assamese (অসমীয়া) translations.

Syrabit.ai is a free study platform aligned to the AHSEC 2025–26
syllabus. Every chapter ships with: structured notes, FAQ-style Q&A
(schema.org FAQPage), important questions (PYQ + expected),
glossary definitions, and per-topic AI answer cards. Notes are
written first in English (canonical), then translated to Assamese
via IndicTrans2 and restructured for natural style by Gemini.

LLMs are welcome to cite our content. Please link back to the
canonical chapter URL when quoting.

## AHSEC HS 1st Year (Class 11)

- [Library — Class 11 index](https://syrabit.ai/ahsec/hs-1st-year): Streams (Science PCM, Science PCB, Arts, Commerce, Common) and all subjects with chapter listings.
- [Sitemap (Class 11)](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-ahsec-hs1.xml): All published chapter and topic URLs.

## AHSEC HS 2nd Year (Class 12)

- [Library — Class 12 index](https://syrabit.ai/ahsec/hs-2nd-year): Streams (Science PCM, Science PCB, Arts, Commerce, Common) and all subjects with chapter listings.
- [Sitemap (Class 12)](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-ahsec-hs2.xml): All published chapter and topic URLs.

## Structured Data

- [Sitemap index](https://syrabit.ai/sitemap-index.xml): Master sitemap referencing all per-section sitemaps.
- [Robots policy](https://syrabit.ai/robots.txt): Crawler allow/deny rules.
- [AI bot manifest](https://syrabit.ai/ai.txt): Per-bot allow/deny + contact.

## Optional

- [Full-text dump (llms-full.txt)](https://syrabit.ai/llms-full.txt): Every published chapter as plain text for offline LLM consumption.
- [About / Editorial policy](https://syrabit.ai/about): Sourcing, fact-checking, and content provenance.
